Wayfinding: back arrow, canonical breadcrumbs, mode chips on section indexes (#348)

* docs: wayfinding design spec (adversarially reviewed)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01GSkMaKRmk9hJcBzmT69mJR

* feat: wayfinding — back arrow, canonical breadcrumb trails, mode chips on section indexes

Back arrow fused into Breadcrumbs (targets the parent crumb; pointer-only on
tablet via the redundant-link pattern, single accessible back link on phone).
Canonical trail builders in breadcrumb-trails.ts unify crumb vocabulary with
the mode chips (Sort/Decide) and reparent Set aside under Sort. Chips gain
activeExact for truthful aria-current on Pool/Items.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01GSkMaKRmk9hJcBzmT69mJR

* fix: fold adversarial code-review findings into wayfinding

Unclip the 44px back-arrow hit area (scroll region moved off the nav), name
the breadcrumb landmark, truncate the phone back label, canonical trail in
all three compare branches, chevron params truly match the carousel glyph,
rounded-control token, completeness guard + null-number exception test on
the trail builders, activeExact component test, lean page-test chip blocks.

webServer.command: npm run build && npx next start --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3100

specs.title: authenticate
a11y: core authed screens — no serious/critical violations (light)
a11y: core authed screens — no serious/critical violations (dark)
a11y: unauthenticated login — no serious/critical violations (light)
a11y: unauthenticated login — no serious/critical violations (dark)
pool-first: Make items routes to the pool
both: Photo pool renders before Items, with the item preview shown
items-first: View all items routes to the items grid
empty: offers exactly one add-photos action and no pool/items sections
back arrow on a deep page: the tablet pointer shortcut lands on the parent route
phone: the trail collapses to a single accessible back link
keyboard traversal reaches header → primary section → secondary actions → owner utilities in order
authenticated storageState reaches /collections
authenticated storageState survives a fresh protected navigation
login offers Google only and starts without a session
/signup redirects to /login

suites.title: compare — which do you love more?

specs.title: renders the prompt, two choice cards, and quiet Tie/Skip escapes
tapping a card chooses it and the next pair (or a graceful end) appears
gentle progress text appears after a comparison is made
crash-reload: the gate drains pending decisions in queue order BEFORE the round re-renders
pagehide: a still-pending decision is delivered on unload and persists
owner types the name to permanently delete, then lands on /collections

suites.title: delete photo from the item carousel

specs.title: deleting the only photo (real DELETE) returns the add-photos CTA
the items grid requests the resized card width (w=640)
the item-detail hero requests the large width (w=1280)
rotate from a card fires a persisted PATCH and announces the result
zoom in changes the image scale
flips to the next photo and shows the details card
the view control opens the zoom/rotate viewer
(1) un-block → purge chain: 409 → remove-from-sorts → purge → gone
(2) finalized dead-end: remove-from-sorts leaves 1 finalized, purge stays 409
(3) authz: a non-owner is 403 on BOTH ops; item + results survive
login page fits the viewport and has tap-sized controls
collections page renders the grid without overflow when authenticated
owner sees both RoleBadges and the email-only InviteForm
Remove is gated to the non-owner row
submitting a valid email shows the announced success
set aside the focused item → it leaves the flow → inline undo + list bring-back both return it
setting aside the LAST item empties the queue, yet the inline 'Bring back' notice stays visible AND clickable
no ceiling: neither triage nor the set-aside list shows an 'of N' total or remaining count
defer the focused item → it leaves the pass → resurfaces last with the patient-waiting skin
no ceiling: progress is affirm-only — never an 'of N' total or remaining count
saving a new display name reflects in the header without a reload
profile links to tutorials and the completed sort tutorial

suites.title: results page — Onward renders as a separate gentle section

specs.title: Onward is its own section, holding the Onward item and not the full ranking

suites.title: draft result — manual re-rank persists through the bulk endpoint

specs.title: within-tier and cross-tier hand-order both persist across a reload
renders tier sections, hero images, and the Onward tier via slug/number URLs

suites.title: session uniqueness — create after set-aside; paused collection card

specs.title: set the session aside → start a NEW sort → it succeeds (201, lands on triage)
a paused session shows its card on the collection page → Resume un-pauses and returns to the sort

suites.title: sort — 'Take a break' pause → calm landing → Resume

specs.title: pause from triage chrome → land on the calm paused landing (New Session gated) → Resume back to the sort

suites.title: collection — set a session aside (two-step) → persistent Undo → restore

specs.title: set aside (reveal → confirm) → the Undo notice survives the card disappearing → Undo restores the active-session card
/ redirects to /login when logged out
/collections redirects to /login when logged out
/login renders the Google-only auth surface without overflow
renders the item's hero photo, requested via the collection ULID
triage renders the current item via slug/number URLs (never a raw ULID)
reload preserves the session (still on triage, same item)
StartSessionForm at /sort/new creates a session and lands DIRECTLY on triage

suites.title: session detail → See what you love most → results

specs.title: triage a decision → compare a pair → the trigger creates a populated result and navigates to it
if the result can't be created, a soft message appears, the button re-enables, and we stay put
goto of a protected sort URL redirects to /login
goto of a protected compare URL redirects to /login

suites.title: usage round — do you use this?

specs.title: hub usage card → two answers + one skip → recap counts the two answers, not the skip
reload lands the pending answer before the round re-renders (crash-reload catch-up)
zero-collection first login walks through and hands off
finishing then exploring dismisses for good
leave tutorial mid-walkthrough dismisses too
